notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing on Adoption of Annual Budget 2026-2027
notices.agenda_text:
ERDA
Notice of Public Hearing Regarding Adoption of Erda City Fiscal Year 2026-2027 Budget 


	Notice is hereby given by Erda City a municipal corporation of the state of Utah, located in Tooele County, of a public meeting to adopt Erda's Fiscal Year 2024-2025 Budget on Thursday May 28th, 2026 beginning at 7:00 p.m.  at the Erda City Offices next to the Fire Station on 2163 W Erda Way, Erda UT, 84074. The geographic area that will be affected by the City's Budget is the entire area of Erda.  Further information regarding the Erda City Annual Budget Fiscal Year 2026-2027 and a copy may be obtained from the City Recorder at the address and telephone number set forth below. Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, Individuals needing special accommodations should contact Craig Smith at 435-830-2802.

Erda
2163 W. Erda Way
Erda UT, 84074
435-243-5577

notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing on Requests to Disconnect from Erda City
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
ERDA CITY PROPOSED DISCONNECTION PETITIONS
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN as required by Utah Code Ann. §10-2-501 that the Erda City Council will hold a public hearing to consider two separate petitions for the disconnection of certain real property from the corporate limits of Erda City.
The public hearing will be held on May 14, 2026, at 7:00 p.m., at the Deseret Peak Complex, 2930 Hwy 112, Tooele, UT, 84074.
In the public hearing, any person may speak and submit documents regarding the disconnection proposal.
Written comments/documents may be submitted to: Jennifer Poole, Erda City Recorder jpoole@erda.gov (435) 243-5577
A copy of the disconnection petition is available for public inspection during regular business hours at the Erda City Fire Station, 2163 W Erda Way, Erda, Utah 84074 and on the Erda City Website at erda.gov
DATED this 20th day of April, 2026.
/s/ Jennifer Poole Erda City Recorder
PUBLISH: __________, 2026

notices.title: Erda City Council Emergency Meeting
notices.agenda_text:
Notice is hereby given that the Erda City Council will hold an emergency meeting on Friday March 27th, 2026 at 6:30 PM hold a closed session pursuant to Utah Code §52-4-205(1) for a strategy session to discuss imminent litigation requiring immediate council direction. The meeting will be held at the Erda City Fire Station/Office, located at 2163 West Erda Way, Erda, Utah


Call to Order
Roll Call
Motion and Vote to Enter Closed Session (reason: imminent litigation requiring immediate council direction)
Conduct Closed Session
Adjournment 


**All handouts for this meeting can be found on the city's website erda.gov under the calendar section**

Board may elect to go into a closed session which will not be open to the public pursuant to Utah Code Ann. §52-4-205(1).
**Format and Verbiage to be used when going into a closed session
'I move that we temporarily recess the Council meeting to go into a closed meeting for a strategy session to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation.'
 
The motion needs a second and a roll call vote.
 
The Chair then makes this statement:   'The motion passes and the Council will go into closed meeting for a strategy session to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation that will be held in this room.'


Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, Individuals needing special accommodations should contact Larry Kimpel at 435-354-9216
